description: This file contains server-side handler functions for managing booking guests, including adding guests, validating permissions, building calendar events, and sending notifications within a booking system.

methods.name: addGuestsHandler
methods.description: Main handler to add guests to a booking, including permission validation, attendee update, calendar event creation, and notification sending.

methods.name: getBooking
methods.description: Fetches a booking by ID, throws error if not found.

methods.name: validateUserPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to modify the booking.

methods.name: validateGuestsFieldEnabled
methods.description: Ensures the 'guests' field is enabled for the event type.

methods.name: getOrganizerData
methods.description: Retrieves organizer data for a given user ID.

methods.name: deduplicateGuestEmails
methods.description: Removes duplicate guest emails based on base email.

methods.name: getBlacklistedEmails
methods.description: Retrieves blacklisted guest emails from environment variables.

methods.name: getEmailVerificationRequirements
methods.description: Checks if guest emails require verification.

methods.name: sanitizeAndFilterGuests
methods.description: Filters and sanitizes guest list, removing duplicates, blacklisted, and unverified emails.

methods.name: updateBookingAttendees
methods.description: Updates the booking with new attendee information.

methods.name: prepareAttendeesList
methods.description: Prepares attendee data for calendar event creation.

methods.name: buildCalendarEvent
methods.description: Constructs a calendar event object from booking and attendee data.

methods.name: updateCalendarEvent
methods.description: Updates the calendar with the new event details.

methods.name: sendGuestNotifications
methods.description: Sends notifications to guests about their addition to the booking.
